entities.name: Jiří Šejba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Šejba is a Czech retired ice hockey forward who played eleven games in the National Hockey League for the Buffalo Sabres in the 1990–91 season. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1979 to 2000, was spent in the Czechoslovak and Czech leagues. Internationally Šejba played for the Czechoslovak national team at multiple World Championships, winning gold in 1985, and at the 1988 Winter Olympics.
